description: Pacific energy transition-extractives nexus integrated dataset. Just Transitions and the Pacific Project (dataset) is a data set deposited in bl.standrew by its authors Elenore Lèbre, Emilka Skrzypek (University of Queensland). Output from a project titled: Just transition: A new framework for responsible extraction of energy transition metals for the renewable energy sector. Funded by the British Academy, Award Reference: COVJT210062. The dataset data set maps energy transition resources and mining concessions against composite ESG indicators. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. Formats: Excel. Size stated: 1MB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
